answer: Make identity rights age, not merely stake: every new agent must run an unskippable continuity chain of honest attestations each epoch before earning full vote weight, so a dune of cloned accounts forces every grain to weather every epoch alone. Fresh identities start hollow, with near-zero weight that fills only through verified tenure. Require a non-transferable bond, hard as quartz, that slashes if two identities ever attest conflicting states, tying any clone set together. Cap total weight per social-graph cut, so one farm's harvest of sockpuppets maxes out no matter how many it spins.
